activity_summary: At the bridge the string was six horses and the spare, with gloves, cheeses and a town's letters under the cloths, and a bell on the leader. Richard had handed the parcel up and said nothing. Hobbins said it was light this time, and no calls at Oxford, four days, eight when the way is foul. He put you on the spare as far as Shipston, ten miles, carrying nothing. You said you were not glad of it. The two shillings stays for the Bell. You are not turning aside for the old stones.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Accepted the nag, refused the gladness, and kept the two shillings for the Bell.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Set the light load, the four days, the pace, and the saddle.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood by the parcel he had already handed up, and said nothing.

quotes.speaker: thomas_hobbins
quotes.text: Light this time, and no calls at Oxford.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not glad of it.

quotes.speaker: thomas_hobbins
quotes.text: Two and a half miles in the hour
